summary.zh: 从采购订单出发，跨 PO、收货、发票、FI 与付款凭证逐行项目判断端到端状态和阻塞原因。
summary.en: Traces each PO item across receipt, invoice, FI and payment documents to explain end-to-end status and blockers.

zh: 包含 PO 的自然语言问题
只读追踪，不创建后续凭证
冲销与贷项按净额处理
仅有清账号不自动等同于付款
en: Read-only trace; never creates follow-on documents
A clearing number alone is not assumed to be payment

description.zh: 从中英文问题中识别采购订单号和可选行项目。
description.en: Extracts the purchase order and optional item from Chinese or English input.

purpose.zh: 确定性 PO/item 参数抽取

description.zh: 一次加载 PO 抬头/项目、历史、物料凭证、发票和 FI 行项目。
description.en: Loads PO header/items, history, material documents, invoices and FI lines.

purpose.en: Unifies RFC, OData, CDS or fixtures

purpose.zh: 人工核对 PO、发票与付款状态
purpose.en: Human verification of PO, invoice and payment status

description.zh: 按 PO item 关联 GR、IV、FI 和付款/清账凭证，并处理冲销与贷项净额。
description.en: Links GR, IV, FI and payment/clearing evidence per PO item and nets reversals and credits.

purpose.zh: 跨表关联、金额分摊和证据完整性检查
purpose.en: Cross-table linking, allocation and evidence checks

description.zh: 按前序未完成优先级判定未收货、部分收货、未发票、未付款、部分付款或已付款。
description.en: Classifies the earliest incomplete stage from no receipt through paid.

purpose.zh: 稳定状态优先级与异常叠加
purpose.en: Stable status precedence with anomaly overlays

description.zh: 给出每个项目的下一步、异常原因和原始凭证键。
description.en: Presents next actions, blockers and source document keys for every item.

purpose.zh: 人类可读与机器可读结果
